senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) sack, sackcloth. Sifra Sh’mini, Par. 6, ch. VIII (ref. to Lev. XI, 32) מה שק מיוחד וכ׳ as sack, which is specified, is something spun and woven &c.; Sabb. 64ᵃ. Sifra l. c. אין לי אלא שק העשוי וכ׳ I may think that only sackcloth made of goats’ hair is meant.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 20b:6">Succ. 20ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 4:14">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 14</cite> <he>של שק</he> a mat made of sackcloth.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a:2">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>התורה חוגרת שק וכ׳</he> the Torah, girt with sackcloth, stands before the Lord &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שַׂקִּים</he>, <he>שַׂקִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 62a">Sabb. 62ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01440"><he>סַק</he> II</cite>; a. e.
